Name: CuterFatterPigs
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]At this time there is no difference between the baby and adult pigs with this mod because I honestly suck at downsizing/adjusting the art to be smaller. If anyone wants to make baby pigs for these please feel free and if you would let me include it in this mod I would be very grateful and will be sure to credit you for your contribution! [/color]

[color=#f1f1f1]To Install:[/color]
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your baby pig.xnb and pig.xnb files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
4. Done! Launch the game and enjoy adorably fat oinkers!

Downloads.Description: Replace the pig and babypigs in your animal files with these and you're good to go!
